newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Continental Air cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Continental Air cut.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it downgraded Continental Airlines Inc to hold from buy.

-- said airline workers throughout industry are clamoring for higher wages, and the wage situation at Continental has the potential to "substantially reduce" earnings since wages at Houston-based Continental are about 20 percent below the industry average.
-- said continued strength in demand for air travel and Continental's cost controls will lead to slightly improved operating results in 1997.
-- Continental was down 1/4 to 29-3/8 at midday.
